title: Routines
selectCompany: Select a company to view routines.

concurrencyModes.coalesce_if_active: If a run is already active, keep just one follow-up run queued.
concurrencyModes.always_enqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if the routine is already running.
concurrencyModes.skip_if_active: Drop new trigger occurrences while a run is still active.

catchUpModes.skip_missed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
catchUpModes.enqueue_missed_with_cap: Catch up missed schedule windows in capped batches after recovery.
